proposal.claim:
ORIGIN. reports/SCOUT.jsonl line index 4 (codex, 2026-09-03T14:36:05Z, slug
leveraged-binance-usd-m-perpetual-short-whose-collateral) -- the same line H0017 and H0019 took and the line
CLAUDE.md section 7b names as this family's payer. This is the FOURTH registration on ONE payer and must not be
counted as a fourth mechanism: section 6 says a tree re-arranging one idea is narrower than its hypothesis count
suggests, and by H0019's own accounting H0017's 90 rows plus H0019's 72 are already 162 rows on this idea, both
of them now closed. If the payer is not there they die together, and 162 of them already have.

WHO IS STRUCTURALLY PAYING, AND WHY THEY KEEP DOING IT. A Binance USD-M position past maintenance margin is
closed by the venue's own risk engine with an immediate-or-cancel order and a clearance fee. It chooses neither
its price nor its timing and it cannot wait: the order is sent because a margin ratio crossed a line, not
because anyone judged the price. They keep doing it because leverage is the whole reason to hold a perpetual
rather than spot -- the venue sells it, and its fee schedule and insurance fund are underwritten on the
leveraged base rebuilding after every flush, which it has after every flush this archive contains. It would end
if maintenance margin were negotiable, which is not a feature of this product. What is collected on the other
side is compensation for immediacy. Nothing in this rule reads panel.funding_rate; the funding the evaluator
charges bar by bar is a cost of holding, never an input to a decision.

WHY I DID NOT BRING A NEW PAYER, WHICH IS THE FIRST THING A REVIEWER SHOULD PRESS ON. I read all 39 lines of
reports/SCOUT.jsonl, not only the four the CCI family has used. The reason none of the other 38 is here is not
that they are weak -- several are stronger and better sourced -- it is that they are not expressible. Their
observables are overwhelmingly CALENDAR-anchored: a fixed UTC hour (line 0 quarterly delivery 07:00-08:00, line
5 Deribit expiry 07:30-08:00, line 7 Dual Investment 07:30-08:00, line 14 CME 15:00-16:00 London, lines 37 and
38 the 16:00 New York NAV instant), a weekday or week boundary (line 8 the Monday 00:00 UTC maker-tier reset,
line 17 the 00:00 UTC qualification reset, line 33 weekends against US bank days), a month or quarter boundary
(line 20 the 31 December tax boundary, line 25 lender reporting dates, line 34 monthly power invoices), a
published announcement timestamp (lines 1, 3, 13, 19, 22, 23, 32), or an external publish clock (line 29 oracle
heartbeats, line 36 MakerDAO's 1577-second hop). Neither TrialConfig nor SignalTrialConfig has a single field
that can express a time of day, a day of week, a date, a calendar window or a symbol group. `rule` is one of
five names. Two of those five read funding and belong to closed H0002 and closed H0006; the other three read
CCI and belong to closed H0017 and closed H0019. So as of this pass EVERY rule function the evaluator can
express sits inside a closed family, and no proposal written from this vocabulary can offer a new rule
FUNCTION. What it can still offer is a different TRADE built on a signal that exists. I state this plainly
rather than dressing a fifth funding re-skin in a new payer's name, because that is the move that killed H0009
and H0016. The binding constraint on this project is no longer the supply of mechanisms; it is that the
evaluator cannot speak a calendar, and the most valuable next piece of work is probably a rule form that can,
not another hypothesis.

WHAT THE TWO CLOSURES ACTUALLY RECORDED, READ FROM configs/closed/ AND NOT FROM MEMORY. H0017 closed on its
clause 3, SPIKE on 7 of 9 symbols along timeframe_hours. H0019 closed on its clause 4, SPIKE on 8 of 9 symbols
along filter_level -- and its closure record states that its OTHER four clauses survived: clause 1 was cleared
by cell (filter_level 120, filter_timeframe 48) at calmar > 0 on 7 of 9, clause 2 by zero liquidations at every
symbol's best cell, clause 3 by only LTCUSDT's 19 trades falling under the floor of 20, and clause 5 by only
XRPUSDT selecting the loosest filter. So neither family was closed for having no edge. What is recorded dead is
(a) UNCONDITIONAL relaxation held to indicator state -- H0017's reversion row is negative on all 45 cells, mean
-0.63 against the breakout row's +0.22 -- and (b) the shape of the two axes that were gridded. Both of those
axes belong to the SIGNAL's construction. No CCI hypothesis has ever put an axis on the TRADE.

THE RULE SHAPE, AND WHY I CALL THE EXIT PART OF IT. All 162 CCI rows ever recorded closed a position on
indicator state: _two_sided returns `exit_ = (~finite) | (abs(value) <= exit_level)` with exit_level 50, and
cci_mtf returns `trend_gone | resolved`; behind both sat max_hold_days 5.0 and a 25 % stop. `take_profit` has
never been set on a single Track B row in this project -- H0002 did not grid it, H0006 fixed it null, H0017 and
H0019 left it at the dataclass default of None. This hypothesis switches the indicator exit OFF and closes the
trade on a fixed price distance or a one-day clock instead. I read orc/eval/signal_rules.py::_two_sided rather
than inferring it: the guard is `enter_level > exit_level >= 0.0`, so exit_level 0.0 is legal, and it makes
`exit_` fire only where `abs(value) <= 0.0` -- a reading of exactly zero, which a float CCI does not produce --
or where the reading is not finite, which is a symbol whose window MAD went to zero and is an honest exit rather
than a decision. I also read orc/eval/signal.py: `qty = cash * leverage / fill` and the target is
`fill + side * take_profit * cash / qty`, so at leverage 1.0 take_profit is exactly a price move from the fill,
0.005 is 0.5 % and 0.04 is 4 %. And `max_hold_bars = p.bars(max_hold_days)`, so 1.0 is 24 bars on the 1h clock.

WHY THAT IS THE SHAPE THIS PAYER PREDICTS. The scouted sentence names a duration and an exhaustion --
"asymmetric continuation and elevated volume, followed by RELAXATION ONCE THE COMPULSORY BUY FLOW IS EXHAUSTED".
An immediacy premium is a bounded concession repaid quickly. A rule that waits for a 5-day CCI to come back
inside +-50 is not harvesting that concession; it is holding a directional bet whose horizon is set by an
indicator, and it hands the premium back if the move resumes. H0017's own surface reading is consistent with
that failure mode rather than with a payer: the positive mass sat on AVAXUSDT (0.41-0.81 across the whole
timeframe range) and DOGEUSDT (0.32-3.01), while BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT -- which carry by far the largest absolute
liquidation flow -- had best cells of 0.27 and -0.03. That is the ranking of cross-sectional volatility, which
is what a days-long directional hold on a high-beta symbol produces. A bounded bracket is the shape that
separates the two readings, because its holding period is set by the trade and not by the symbol's volatility.

WHY THE DUEL IS KEPT, AND WHY IT IS THE TEST. `rule` carries both halves of the scouted sentence at the SAME
bracket. Continuation and relaxation cannot both be right about one payer at one horizon; signal_rules.py says
so in its own docstring -- "if both pay, what is being read is not forced flow" -- and clause 5 below is written
on exactly that. This is why the grid is not a single rule with a wider axis: a one-rule grid could only report
that something paid, and the pair can report that the explanation is wrong.

WHY H0017's 0-OF-9 ON REVERSION IS NOT ALREADY THE ANSWER, AND WHERE THAT ARGUMENT IS WEAK. Those 45 negative
cells were measured with the indicator exit. Under a bracket the relaxation trade closes at a fixed distance and
never waits for a full mean reversion, so the equity curve is a different function of the price path and the
0-of-9 does not transfer. That is an ARGUMENT, not a measurement, and I mark it as one.

THE GROUND ON WHICH THIS SHOULD BE KILLED, RAISED AGAINST MYSELF BEFORE THE REVIEWER HAS TO. Two grounds, and I
have no rebuttal to either beyond what is written above. (a) If the reviewer holds that an exit clause is a
PARAMETER rather than part of the rule shape, then this is H0017 with three numbers moved -- exit_level 50 to 0,
max_hold_days 5 to 1, take_profit None to a grid -- and it dies on the ground that killed H0011, H0012 and
H0016: an untried numeric axis is not a new rule shape. My only answer is that the three moves are one change,
that they replace an indicator-state exit with a bounded bracket, and that no clause of H0017's or H0019's kill
condition addressed the exit at all. (b) If the reviewer holds that section 6's "if that idea is dead the whole
tree is" already applies -- one payer, three readings, two closures, 162 rows -- then this is a fourth
arrangement of a dead idea and should be killed on that ground. My only answer is that neither closure was a
no-edge closure, and that both fired on the shape of an axis belonging to the signal rather than to the trade.

WHY take_profit IS THE AXIS AND WHY IT CARRIES FOUR ORDINAL LEVELS. It is the payer's own quantity: how much of
a concession the forced order leaves on the table before the flow is exhausted. 0.005, 0.01, 0.02 and 0.04 are
0.5 %, 1 %, 2 % and 4 % price moves at leverage 1.0, spanning nearly an order of magnitude so that "one step
either side" means something. The floor is set by arithmetic and not by taste: the round trip is 4.5 bps taker
plus 1.0 bps slippage on each side, 11 bps, so 0.005 is about 4.5x the cost and a level below it would be an
axis that cannot pay whatever the mechanism does.

WHAT THAT AXIS DOES AND DOES NOT ISOLATE, SAID NOW SO A MONOTONE READING IS NOT OVERSOLD LATER. Raising
take_profit does three things at once: it raises the payoff per win, it lowers the hit rate, and it raises the
share of trades closed by the one-day clock rather than by the target. The recorded metrics carry no exit-reason
breakdown, so a monotone reading along this axis may NOT be reported as "the concession is larger than X". It
may only be reported as the joint movement of those three.

WHY THE ENTRY IS FROZEN AT H0017's. timeframe_hours 4.0 is the candle the owner named; lookback_days 5.0,
enter_level 100.0, leverage 1.0, stop_loss 0.25 and capital 10000 are H0017's own fixed block, kept unchanged
so that the exit is the only thing this registration varies against a family whose numbers already exist. The
stop stays a tail bound at 25 % of margin rather than becoming the other arm of the bracket, precisely so the
take_profit axis is not confounded by a stop moving with it. leverage is not on the grid: KT-2 closed leverage
above 1x and there is no reason to reopen it on a signal rule.

THAT THE ENTRY FIRES IS READ FROM THE RECORD, NOT ASSUMED. H0017 recorded cells at timeframe_hours 4.0 on all
nine symbols (its surface reading quotes SOLUSDT 4h at 1.17 and BNBUSDT 4h at 0.33), so the +-100 entry on the
4-hour candle produces trades on this universe. H0019, whose regime filter removes entries this rule keeps,
still recorded 19 to 127 trades per symbol. Shortening the hold from 5 days to 1 lets the same entry set be
taken more often, not less. So clause 3's floor of 20 is a live check rather than a predictable failure.

WHAT THIS PROBE CANNOT SEE, SAID BEFORE ANY NUMBER EXISTS. The liquidation stream, the forced-order feed, open
interest and the mark price are not in this archive. A displaced price is EVIDENCE of forced flow, not a
MEASUREMENT of it, and ordinary aggressive trading displaces price too, so no result here may be reported as a
measurement of forced liquidation -- only as a partial test of it. Four specific gaps, unchanged from H0019
because nothing about them has changed. (1) The payer's sharpest fingerprint is asymmetry: a liquidated short
must BUY. _two_sided sets entry[hot] and entry[cold] symmetrically and no field of SignalTrialConfig restricts a
CCI rule to one side, so asymmetry stays untested here exactly as it did in H0017 and H0019. (2) "Elevated
volume" is the other half of the scouted observable and no rule reads volume. (3) enter_level stays at 100, so
the +-200 extreme is untested; readings past 200 are a SUBSET of what this enters on, so a FAIL here is a FAIL
at the band with the extreme diluted into it and never a FAIL at the extreme. (4) A cascade and an ordinary
aggressive move are indistinguishable to this rule by construction.

WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT IN THE KILL CONDITION, AND THE COST OF LEAVING IT OUT. H0017 wrote a cost-stress
clause and a gross_collected clause and BOTH were recorded unevaluable at closure, because the surface payload
carries neither re-priced cells nor the funding-leg split; an unrun check is not a check that passed and writing
one again would buy the same nothing. So every clause below reads only quantities the H0017 and H0019 surfaces
demonstrably carried: per-cell `calmar`, and at each symbol's best cell `shape`, `independent_paths_best`,
`n_liquidations_best` and the best cell's own parameters. The price this pays is that this family CANNOT be
closed here for the funding coupon having carried the curve. The structural mitigation is an argument and not a
measurement: the rule takes both sides, so unlike H0002 and H0006 it does not sit on one side of the coupon.
Costs are the project defaults and are charged in the recorded numbers even though no clause stresses them.

SIZE. Two rules by four take_profit levels is 8 cells over 9 symbols, 72 configurations -- a probe under the
96-cell ceiling, 1.03 % of the 7,010 trials recorded as of run 324595c30eb4. Depth is not requested and is not
earned: only if this probe survives every clause below may a second registration under a new id enumerate the
+-200 extreme, the fast timeframe, the hold length and the placebo control on enter_level that would say whether
the extreme is doing any work at all.
proposal.kill_condition:
NOTATION AND FROZEN COUNTING RULES. Nine symbols s. Eight cells (R, T), R in {cci_reversion,
cci_breakout} and T in {0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.04}. C(s, R, T) is the recorded `calmar`. "The best cell" of a
symbol means the cell the surface itself records as that symbol's best, which on Track B is the maximum recorded
`calmar`; if two cells tie exactly, cci_breakout before cci_reversion, and then the lower T. That selection rule
is frozen here because codex killed H0018 for leaving "the best cell" undefined across symbols. At the best cell
the surface records `shape`, `independent_paths_best` (which on Track B is n_trades) and `n_liquidations_best`,
and clauses 2, 3, 4 and 6 read only those. A cell that does not record at all -- run_signal_trial raising
UnsupportedConfig('no_trades_fired') -- counts as FAILING every clause it appears in and never as passing one.
No clause reads `gross_collected`, `funding_collected`, `win_rate`, a cost-stressed value, or any number
belonging to another hypothesis, because each of those was either recorded unevaluable at an earlier closure or
is not this family's to grade itself on. Every threshold below is frozen now, before any of these 72
configurations has been run.

1. NO EDGE. Closed if no single cell (R, T) reaches C > 0 on at least 5 of the 9 symbols. This is deliberately
the identical bar, on the identical nine-symbol universe, that H0002, H0006, H0017 and H0019 were graded
against, so the five are directly comparable and this family cannot be graded on an easier scale than the ones
it follows.

2. RUIN. Closed if `n_liquidations_best` is above 0 on any of the 9 symbols. At leverage 1.0 behind a 25 % stop
and a one-day hold a liquidation should be unreachable, and if one is recorded the Calmar is describing how
close to ruin the shape ran. KT-2 closed that direction already and this family does not get to reopen it by
accident.

3. TOO THIN TO BE AN EXPERIMENT. Closed if `independent_paths_best` is below 20 on 5 or more of the 9 symbols.
On Track B the effective independent-path count IS the trade count, and a curve made of a handful of episodes is
a handful of experiments however it looks. H0019 recorded 19 to 127 trades per symbol on a strictly narrower
entry set, so this floor is live rather than decorative; if it fires here it is a finding about how rare the
entry is and not a measurement failure.

4. SPIKE. Closed if the recorded shape of the best cell is SPIKE on 5 or more of the 9 symbols. take_profit
carries four ordinal levels spanning 0.5 % to 4 % precisely so this is answerable. This clause is word-for-word
H0017's clause 3 and H0019's clause 4, and it is the clause that closed both of them, at 7 of 9 and 8 of 9. If
the bracketed reading peaks at a corner of the target axis exactly as the unconditional one peaked at a corner
of the timeframe axis and the conditional one at a corner of the level axis, then what this family is reading is
a corner of a grid and not a payer, and that is worth knowing whatever clause 1 says.

5. BOTH HALVES PAY, SO IT IS NOT FORCED FLOW. For each rule R let W(R) be the maximum, over the four values of
T, of the number of symbols with C(s, R, T) > 0. Closed if W(cci_reversion) >= 5 AND W(cci_breakout) >= 5.
Continuation and relaxation are opposite readings of one payer at one horizon and cannot both be right; if both
clear the same majority bar at the same bracket, what a bounded bracket on a volatile series is collecting is
not an immediacy premium, and the payer is not identified. This is the reason the pair is on one grid, it is
signal_rules.py's own stated reason for writing the pair as one function, and it can close the family even when
clause 1 is met.

6. THE DISTANCE IS NOT WHAT PAYS. Closed if the best cell's take_profit is 0.04 -- the widest target on the grid
-- on 5 or more of the 9 symbols. The mechanism claims a BOUNDED concession repaid before the forced flow is
exhausted, so it predicts the edge does not live at the widest target, which at a one-day hold is the setting
where the target is least often reached and the trade is most often closed by the clock, i.e. an ordinary
directional bet on a 4-hour displacement. Under a flat surface each of the four levels wins about 2.25 of the 9
symbols, so 5 is a real majority and not a coin flip. This clause is the only one that can distinguish "the
bracket harvested a premium" from "the entry was long a symbol that went up for a day", on quantities this
surface actually records.

WHAT SURVIVAL WOULD REQUIRE, on the record before the numbers and not softenable afterwards: one single cell
(R, T) with C > 0 on at least 5 of the 9 symbols, no liquidation recorded at any symbol's best cell, at least 5
symbols whose best cell fired 20 trades or more, a shape that is not SPIKE on a majority, exactly one of the two
rules clearing the 5-of-9 bar rather than both, and a best cell inside the target axis rather than at its widest
level on a majority. Only then may a second registration under a new id enumerate the +-200 extreme, the hold
length, the fast timeframe, and the enter_level placebo that would say whether the +-100 extreme is doing any
work at all. A FAIL on any clause above is a publishable result and closes the bracketed reading of this
payer -- the last arrangement of it the evaluator's present vocabulary can express.

verdict.reason: [claude] 제안된 72셀 전부를 원장 0행으로 run_signal_trial에 그대로 돌려보니(하네스는 H0017의 원장 값 ADAUSDT 0.07928141, BTCUSDT -0.12706462, SOLUSDT 1.16961771을 비트 단위로 재현) 72셀의 calmar이 전부 음수이고 각 심볼 최적셀의 mdd는 0.826~0.976, 거래수는 973~2,289로 H0017의 357~461에서 2~5배 부풀어 있어, clause 1은 어떤 셀도 C>0을 단 한 심볼도 못 얻는 0/9로, clause 6은 6/9로 이미 발동하고 clause 5의 duel은 W(reversion)=W(breakout)=0이라 애초에 판정 자체가 불가능하다 — 즉 이 등록은 0행짜리 스크립트가 이미 산출한 CLOSED 판정을 사려고 N을 7,010에서 7,082로 영구히 올릴 뿐이다. 더구나 exit_level 50→0, max_hold_days 5→1, take_profit은 모두 SignalTrialConfig의 기존 수치 필드를 evaluator가 exit cap으로 읽는 것이고 entry/side/state 배열은 H0017과 동일하므로, 몇 시간 전 H0020(cci_exhaustion_clock)과 H0021(cci_bounded_concession)을 죽인 section 6 근거가 그대로 적용된다. | [codex] This is a finer parameter grid over the already-closed CCI rule form: disabling the indicator exit via exit_level=0 and varying take_profit/max_hold_days changes existing exit parameters, not the rule shape or payer. The bracket interpretation therefore re-arranges the same forced-liquidation family after 162 registered rows, contrary to sections 6 and 7b.
